description: Get a payment request by id: status (Open/Completed/Cancelled/Expired), pay path, offered currencies, and the underlying draft once the payer committed. Includes changeSignals and changeNotes: what is unusual compared with the account's paid payments (new_address, new_asset, unusual_amount), the same lines the payer sees on the pay page; empty when nothing is unusual. Requires scope drafts:read.
name: get_payment_request
title: Get pay link
